title: A Common Language for Responsible AI: Methods and Insights from a Fieldwide Consensus-Building Effort
snippet: The landscape of AI in healthcare is characterized by a proliferation of guidelines. While many articulate similar principles, they do not always overlap and often lack actionable guidance across the AI lifecycle. This article describes the development of the CHAI Responsible AI Guide...
match_reason: websearch (publication) — Cora Han, Chief Health Data Officer for University of California Health, is a co-author of this paper on responsible AI in healthcare.

title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
snippet: A new documentary confronting a dangerous new era. With the rise of AI and deepfakes, tech-facilitated violence is exacerbating sexism and misogyny toward women and girls in an attempt to control and silence them. The film features expert insights from Dr. Safiya Noble.
